concerns.text: FR-002 (Metric Extraction) requires extraction of T1, T2, gate errors, readout errors, and coupling maps. The plan does not explicitly map any task or module to this requirement; FR‑002 in the plan refers to graph construction, not to performance‑metric extraction.

SC-004 (Time‑Window robustness check) is mentioned in the specification (as part of FR‑004) but the implementation plan only lists LODO, chip‑family exclusion, and p‑value sweep. No step or contract addresses the 30‑day historical performance‑window comparison.

The plan includes FR‑005, FR‑006, and FR‑07 (plot generation, additional robustness checks) which are not present in the specification. These constitute over‑reach and should be either removed or added to the spec as new functional requirements.
